comment: Solar wind speed remains slightly elevated but we still anticipate it to decline somewhat over the next few days. There have been two CMEs over the past 24 hours. One associated with an M3 flare near the east limb should not impact Earth. An earlier CME, potentially associated with a filament lift-off near the west limb may have a small Earth-directed component, although it appears very slow and weak and is unlikely to affect geomagnetic activity significantly, and has an estimated arrival time beyond day three. The High Speed Stream from a small Coronal Hole could potentially become geoeffective at the start of next week, but that is beyond the current forecast period.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
